verdict.rationale: Restate documents trace export, an invocations list showing running, suspended and completed invocations, a CLI and Introspection SQL API for invocation status, and Langfuse tracing for agents. This gives some visibility and a path into an observability stack. Nothing in the pack shows metrics export (failure rates, latencies, queue depths) or alerting. Missing for 10: documented metrics export (e.g. Prometheus/OTel metrics) covering failure rates, latencies and queue depths, built-in or integrated alerting on misbehaving workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
